principle: Ship identity needs a collision-safe diegetic name/registry layer, but the generator must not invent canonical naming rules where none are established.
rules: Canonical ship names and registries are reserved.
Generated display names must be checked against canonical and already-generated active/historical identities within the relevant operator context.
Renaming appends name_history and does not change ship_id.
Registry/hull number is optional until a validated operator allocator exists.
Do not assume Human naval prefixes for alien operators.
Starfleet may use USS when the era/context supports it; exact registry allocation is separate from internal stable_ship_id.
House/clan/family naming may be used only when actual operator culture/ownership state supports it.
safety_rule: If a valid diegetic name cannot be generated confidently, the ship still exists with stable_ship_id and a temporary sensor/traffic designation.
